name: Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque (Red Mosque), Pettah
description: Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque, also known as the Red Mosque, is a stunning Islamic architectural gem in Pettah, Colombo. Its intricate red tiles and ornate minarets stand out against the vibrant backdrop of Pettah’s bustling streets, making it a must-visit for both locals and tourists alike.

name: Dewatagaha Mosque, Maradana
description: Dewatagaha Mosque, located in the heart of Maradana, is a stunning Islamic landmark with intricate architectural details and a rich history dating back centuries. Its serene ambiance and cultural significance make it a must-visit for both locals and tourists alike.

name: Fort Jumma Mosque
description: Fort Jumma Mosque, also known as Fort Jesus, stands majestically at the heart of Colombo’s historic Fort district. This ancient Islamic landmark, built by Portuguese colonizers in the 17th century, offers a glimpse into the city’s rich colonial past and its vibrant Muslim community.
activities: Explore the mosque's historical significance, Learn about the city's multicultural heritage, Take a stroll through the Fort area

name: Sri Lanka Mosque, Slave Island

Its intricate architecture and peaceful ambiance make it a must-visit for both locals and tourists alike.

name: Memon Hanafi Mosque, Pettah
